postInstall.message:
websocket installed.

Wire up the init partial in your layout and (optionally) register a starter
room in one interactive step:

  pos-cli generate run modules/websocket/generators/install

Prefer to wire things up by hand? See the module README for the manual steps:
https://github.com/Platform-OS/pos-modules/blob/master/pos-module-websocket/README.md
